# Ads Yeti

> Ads Yeti is a founder-led paid ads agency (Meta ads and Google ads) that judges campaigns on what happens after the click: leads, follow-up, sales and revenue. The Knowledge Centre answers the questions founders ask before hiring anyone.

- [Knowledge Centre](https://www.adsyeti.com/resources/): hub, browse by topic or question type
- [Blog](https://www.adsyeti.com/resources/blog/): every article

## Leads, CRM & follow-up

- [Why are my Facebook ads getting leads but no sales?](https://www.adsyeti.com/resources/blog/why-facebook-ads-get-leads-but-no-sales/): Cheap leads that never buy usually aren't an ads problem. Here's where the journey actually breaks, and what to check first.
